research.summary: Two checkpoint/inversion refinements distinct from already-inherited external inversion, deferred-Y/XYZZ and direct recovery: (1) denominator-only H checkpoints, (2) tile-local two-level batch inversion. Both reduce checkpoint transport without changing problem dependence. No GPU gain established; hypotheses only.

findings.title: Denominator-only H checkpoints from mixed-add chain
findings.mechanism: Emit/store only the lambda denominator H per step from H-output mixed adds instead of full Z/point checkpoints; reconstruct inversion chain as Z_k=Z0*H0*... and fuse decompress with recovery. Removes separate denominator muls and shrinks per-checkpoint bytes vs full Jacobian stores.

sources.locator: Point Operations mixed addition: jacobian_add_mixed_h madd-2004-hmv (8M+3S) H output for batch inversion; Z=1 specialized (5M+2S); Batch Inversion prefix/suffix scan
sources.supports: Implementation exposes H-output add variants explicitly for batch inversion and separate Z1 fast path; supports denominator-only checkpoint pattern

sources.locator: PR title plus peterdettman comment: Montgomery trick 1 inversion +3 muls each; Jacobian-to-affine table conversion use-case

findings.new_vs_memory: Memory records external checkpoint/batch inversion plus deferred-Y/XYZZ/direct recovery, but not H-output adds or denominator-only checkpoint width. Distinct from reviewed comb/prefetch IDs and from already-inherited direct recovery.
findings.large_gain_case: Removed: larger checkpoint stores/loads and separate denominator-build muls per step. Added: small per-add delta for H-output form (e.g. 8M+3S vs 7M+4S family) plus unchanged 1-inv+3N-mul inversion math. Large only if checkpoints currently spill to DRAM/global and dominate.
findings.risks: If current checkpoints already H-only there is no gain. Must preserve H/Z recurrence liveness across chain; formula change risks consensus/correctness; register/shared pressure from H liveness.
findings.falsification: Mac-only: extract current checkpoint type/bytes per step; CPU-verify H-chain vs full-Z recovery equivalence on random grind scalars; stub-compile reg/shared estimate only, no timing claim.

findings.title: Tile-local Blelloch/GAS two-level batch inversion
findings.mechanism: Replace single global linear prefix chain (O(N) global checkpoint writes/reads) with tiles (e.g. 64): intra-tile Blelloch scan in local/shared, one global aggregate per tile, global compress, single/ few Fermat inversions, then scatter/decompress. Keeps prefix traffic on-chip.

sources.locator: Batch Affine Conversion point_to_affine_batch64: parallel Montgomery inversion for 64 points using Blelloch scan in local memory; WG=64 local lz/lprefix/lscan/linvTot
sources.supports: Worked GPU implementation of tile-local Blelloch inversion with fixed WG and local-memory prefix buffers; author RTX5090 bench numbers are workload-specific, not grinding transfer

sources.locator: Abstract (verified via fetch): Montgomery trick + memory management + 5.56x ECDSA /4.94x ECDH vs SOTA GPU claims; Subjects cs.CR/cs.AR/cs.DC, 22 Dec 2024
sources.supports: Abstract supports batch EC + memory-management scope and author-measured ECDSA/ECDH gains only; compress/decompress, 6N-vs-11N, N>20, GAS 32n-to-sp and 128MB+96MB-vs-20MB details seen only in search snippets, full text not verified - marked limitation

findings.new_vs_memory: Memory records monolithic external inversion and pinning batched ladders/inversion plus 1M-tile builder, but not tile-local Blelloch scan or GAS gather-apply-scatter hierarchy. Distinct from wide/small table and prefetch reviewed IDs.
findings.large_gain_case: Removed: global checkpoint transport of N prefix products (store in compress, reload in decompress). Added: per-tile shared/local traffic, barriers/sync, tile aggregates and small extra scan muls. Large only if global checkpoint traffic is the bottleneck at large batch sizes.
findings.risks: Shared/local budget vs 24KiB PR60 budget and 128-reg prepare pressure; barriers can break overlap; zero-Z/infinity must be filtered or it zeroes tile product; occupancy/divergence risks.
findings.falsification: Mac-only: CPU tile-vs-linear inverse equivalence including infinity/zero-Z filtering; shared-budget accounting for 32B*tilesize vs 24KiB; native ptxas regs/spills estimate only, no GPU timing.
